defects.summary: Same-length corrupted filesystem object was served
defects.repair: Verify the stored SHA-256 before serving bytes, with a fixed-size read buffer.
defects.limits: Adds a full disk read; transfer performance is not qualified.

defects.summary: Scoped npm publication rejected a stock-client attachment name
defects.repair: Use the full scoped package name in the native publish attachment identity, matching npm 11 libnpmpublish.

defects.summary: PostgreSQL driver selected vulnerable transitive x/text release
defects.repair: Upgraded golang.org/x/text to v0.43.0; two reachable findings removed.

defects.summary: OCI native manifest publication could not complete intake into a review-required repository
defects.repair: Separate durable intake-reference checks from serving approval; retain graph references and enforce policy recursively on manifests, tags and inventory.
defects.limits: Graph depth and unique members are bounded at 32 and 4096; legacy manifests without graph metadata fail closed pending repair/re-import.

defects.summary: Initial proxy credential references could cross tenant scope and lacked destination binding
defects.repair: Key private credentials by tenant/ref and bind each to an authentication scheme plus approved URL authority/base path; enforce an operator private-network ceiling independently from repository CIDRs.
defects.limits: Private bindings currently reload on server restart; live rotation remains open.

defects.summary: A denied proxy digest remained available through another path alias in the same repository
defects.repair: Persist canonical tenant/repository/digest decisions and join them for reads, inventory, OCI graph policy and npm metadata. Existing and future aliases inherit the decision.
defects.limits: Manual decisions govern subsequent admitted read snapshots; complete versioned policy/intelligence and in-flight revocation remain open.

defects.summary: npm metadata budget SQL called octet_length on JSONB and caused native-client 503 retries
defects.repair: Measure the JSONB text representation and verify budget handling through real PostgreSQL and stock npm tag/install journeys.

defects.summary: A clean-worktree native record could name a new commit while testing binaries built from the preceding dirty revision
defects.repair: Capture binary-embedded Git/build settings and require exact clean source identity in qualifying native runs; rebuild after the source commit.
defects.limits: Earlier native assertions remain observations, but their clean-build identity is not inferred from Git HEAD. Use the strict named replay.

defects.summary: Unquoted commas in OpenAPI flow-map response descriptions created unintended response properties
defects.first_failure_kind: Reproduced from retained immutable source after the initial observation
defects.repair: Quote response descriptions and parse all 28 responses, checking that the complete descriptions remain strings and no unintended keys appear.

defects.summary: Python publication accepted multipart identity that disagreed with the embedded wheel metadata
defects.repair: Validate bounded archive filename/Name/Version/Requires-Python against exact bytes; derive stored core metadata from the archive. Legacy unvalidated records fail closed and can be enriched by a same-byte writer replay.

defects.summary: Python HTML index tokenizer consumption lost file anchor text, producing an empty proxy index
defects.repair: Read each consuming tokenizer text token once; retain equivalent HTML/JSON binding regression and replay stock pip against an HTML-only preference.

defects.summary: OCI hosted intake accepted an image manifest without its required configuration descriptor
defects.repair: Validate exact manifest structure and descriptors, then check the durable graph and current policy in the publication transaction. Legacy unvalidated manifests fail closed until same-byte writer re-import.
defects.limits: SHA-256 and four OCI/Docker media types; complete standards/parser, upstream, lifecycle and production cases remain open.

defects.summary: An OCI digest previously cached as missing could be selected while its refresh was still fetching
defects.repair: Active fetching returns busy to the snapshot selector; cached readers join bounded retrieval waiting and recheck the final fenced outcome.

defects.summary: Same-key proxy contenders could be rejected before their owner committed the retrieval lease
defects.repair: When local fill admission is full, recheck within the existing bounded wait so same-key contenders can coalesce; capacity limits and cancellation remain enforced.

defects.summary: Implicit OCI graph members had no inspectable cache binding or independent expiry/invalidation fence
defects.repair: Publish per-member cache records atomically; enforce every member at serving; renew dependencies after root 304; bind zero-freshness/stale use to current request receipts.

defects.summary: An older OCI tag fill could overwrite a newer catalog tag binding
defects.repair: Use tenant journal sequence fences for member and tag changes; reject older conflicting publication or tombstones even when wall timestamps move backward.

defects.summary: The native shared-digest denial fixture used two timestamp-sensitive ORAS pushes
defects.repair: Use stock oras tag to point both fixture tags at exactly the same manifest digest.

defects.summary: OCI retrieval rejected an explicitly approved separate CDN delivery authority
defects.repair: Allow explicit OCI delivery sources and signed-query opt-in; manually select each hop, isolate credentials, preserve opaque queries, apply network/budget checks and retain atomic graph/current-policy guards. Sanitize all OCI transport/Location errors.
defects.limits: One real Docker Hub anonymous-token/CloudFront image proof plus owned fixtures; full provider/client/fault/lifecycle conformance remains open.

defects.summary: OCI discovery could not complete referrer or approved signed catalog pages
defects.repair: Walk complete bounded opaque/signed source catalogs, publish atomically, serve current-policy native pages and use legacy referrer-tag fallback only after API 404. Treat graph budget exhaustion explicitly.
defects.limits: Owned source-page fixtures and stock ORAS; mutable catalog concurrency, every provider/client and production-scale/fault qualification remain open.

defects.summary: OCI proxy discarded approved alternate descriptor locators
defects.repair: Carry validated locators transiently, use approved isolated transport, bind exact bytes and recover direct locators from verified retained parents/current referrers catalogs after process restart.
defects.limits: Owned descriptor fixtures and actual native server/ORAS; broad provider/client/fault/lifecycle/production qualification remains incomplete.

defects.summary: Forced direct digest denial lost its explicit 403 response during retrieval failure cleanup
defects.repair: Check current direct digest decisions before cache/source selection and preserve explicit denial/authentication errors after fenced failed-retrieval cleanup; no denied-byte serving was established by the initial failure.
defects.limits: Owned descriptor fixtures and actual native server/ORAS; broad provider/client/fault/lifecycle/production qualification remains incomplete.

defects.summary: Asynchronous activity cursor could skip a slower earlier source event
defects.repair: Assign a durable completion position under the tenant journal lock and page by that position, preserving the separate original source sequence.
defects.limits: Named native/local topology; broader fault, load, multi-host and production campaigns remain open.

defects.summary: Waiting worker claim could outlive credential expiry through transaction-start time
defects.repair: Use current database clock time for public/worker authentication after lock acquisition; revalidate every worker operation.
defects.limits: Named native/local topology; broader fault, load, multi-host and production campaigns remain open.

defects.summary: Queue rejection at proxy completion could strand a fetching lease
defects.repair: Roll back publication, then abandon only the still-current fence in an audited local transaction that requires no saturated outbox capacity; preserve the queue-full response and immediate retry.
defects.limits: Named native/local topology; broader fault, load, multi-host and production campaigns remain open.

defects.summary: Slow OCI chunk body held the tenant journal mutation lock
defects.repair: Stage immutable bounded chunks outside the SQL transaction; renew exact upload/proxy fences and current authorization; commit upload offsets under a short fence check; preserve legacy acknowledged prefixes. Add bounded auditable expired-lease reconciliation that retains bytes.
defects.limits: Native local topology; CAS inventory/GC, holds, historical integrity sweep, production upgrade and broad fault/scale qualification remain required.

defects.summary: A credential could expire during a bulk metadata write callback before transaction commit
defects.repair: Recheck the current public identity after write callbacks as well as after acquiring the tenant lock; expiry rolls back the whole write, including sweep admission.
defects.limits: Named local PostgreSQL profile; full authorization/fault/load/security qualification remains required.

defects.summary: Integrity inspection could block opening a special file beyond its context deadline
defects.repair: Use descriptor-rooted checked regular-file reads and nonblocking/no-follow flags on the qualified Unix platforms; timeouts also stop job lease renewal.
defects.limits: Owned native Unix fixtures; non-Unix, adversarial host/filesystem races, outage, mixed-host/scale and full security qualification remain open.

defects.summary: Publication followed an unsupported tenant namespace symlink into another owned fixture namespace
defects.repair: Create, stage and link canonical objects beneath checked tenant directory descriptors; reject links/special entries and recheck visible storage identity before acknowledgment.
defects.limits: Owned native Unix fixtures; non-Unix, adversarial host/filesystem races, outage, mixed-host/scale and full security qualification remain open.

defects.summary: Worker credentials could expire during a metadata callback before commit
defects.repair: Reauthenticate the dedicated worker purpose after callbacks as well as after tenant-lock acquisition; expiry rolls back the whole effect.
defects.limits: Owned native Unix fixtures; non-Unix, adversarial host/filesystem races, outage, mixed-host/scale and full security qualification remain open.

defects.summary: New initializer prototype issued a server certificate without Authority Key Identifier, rejected by strict stock TLS clients
defects.first_failure_source: uncommitted initializer prototype; exact source hash retained in reproduction record
defects.repair: Parse the issued CA before signing the leaf, preserving its generated Subject Key Identifier and emitting the leaf Authority Key Identifier. Keep client verification enabled.
defects.limits: Native loopback evaluation profile. Full production PKI/credential lifecycle, platforms, security and packaging remain unqualified.

defects.summary: Native initialization catalog inspection had no SQL result bound for an unexpected application schema
defects.repair: Read at most 257 catalog entries and fail initialization for more than 256 instead of retaining and inspecting an unbounded list.
defects.limits: Only initialization of a supposedly empty database; production runtime schema and broader SQL/fault/scale qualification remain separate.

defects.summary: Operator console creation dialog focused Close rather than its first form field
defects.first_failure_source: Uncommitted console prototype on e8f8caba59c90f65a47ffe9ebdf2c28701bbde64; exact source and embedded asset hashes retained.
defects.repair: Show the native dialog before focusing the first enabled form field; preserve the caller for focus restoration and refocus when dialog content changes.
defects.limits: Named Chromium keyboard journey; complete assistive-technology/browser campaign remains required.

defects.summary: A visually hidden absolute table header escaped the mobile scroll container and widened the document
defects.first_failure_source: Uncommitted console prototype on e8f8caba59c90f65a47ffe9ebdf2c28701bbde64; source hash and measured layout retained.
defects.repair: Position the table scroll container so the hidden header stays within its containing block; preserve internal table scrolling.
defects.limits: 390-pixel Chromium repository fixture; all other layouts/platforms remain separately qualified.
